prompt: Create Farfetch'd: tan duck with a dark brown brow shaped like a V, small yellow bill, cream belly, brown wing tips and three crown feathers. One wing carries its characteristic green leek stalk with a white base in each body view. Create sprite components for a Flock Around mod in a smooth rounded flat-color cartoon style, simple clean silhouettes, opaque pastel colors, minimal shading and no heavy outlines. Square transparent canvas, exactly THREE BY THREE equal cells, generous empty gutters, no labels or borders. Top row: detached head left profile, detached head front, detached head back. Middle row: headless left-profile body resting/folded wings, same headless body wings raised, same headless body wings lowered. Bottom row: headless front-facing resting body, headless back-facing resting body, complete assembled left-profile character reference. All five body components must have NO primary head, eyes, beak or head crest; only a short neck attachment. Include whole feet, tail, neck, wings and their tips in each applicable body cell. Consistent anatomy, sizes and palette across views. No scenery, cast shadows, glow, text, gradient backgrounds or clipped limbs.
